row.name: American Electric Power Company Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=2 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.23 tightness=0.91 base_volume_vs_leg=0.99 base_volume_vs_avg=0.95
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 2 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 1.4% vs its 20-SMA, 5.9% over 20 sessions

admission.reason: admitted by the dollar scan on a range-expansion, higher-volume day

claude.reason: The C check is PARTIAL because the base is only 2 sessions, outside Bonde's 3–20 minimum, and visually the shaded consolidation box covers just two bars — there is no meaningful quiet period to measure. The signal bar itself is honest (closes near the high, above the open, with strong volume and range expansion), but a two-bar base is structurally insufficient to call this a proper consolidation setup. The overhead supply from the July–August trading range near 127–128 is now below price, but the dashed resistance line near 127–128 sits just under the current close, and prior heavy-volume distribution bars from that period are visible above.
claude.key_risk: A two-session base provides almost no consolidation evidence; the stock could simply be pausing mid-trend rather than coiling for a burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 129.24 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the open.
